QF.id: VIII Introduction to Clearing and Settlement System_41

question.text: Under the Clearing Member Eligibility Norms, what deposit must a clearing member make to the clearing corporation?

answer.text: A deposit of Rs. 50 lakhs to the clearing corporation, forming part of the clearing member's security deposit
Only retail clients who open trading accounts

explanation.text: The Logic: The Clearing Member Eligibility Norms require a deposit of Rs. 50 lakhs to the clearing corporation, which forms part of the clearing member's security deposit. The Trap: The Rs. 50 lakh deposit is a clearing member obligation to the clearing corporation, not a retail-client requirement, a Professional-Clearing-Member-only requirement, or an exchange-to-SEBI deposit. Note: Page 152 supports the Rs. 50 lakh deposit as part of the clearing member's security deposit under the Clearing Member Eligibility Norms; page 181 separately states that every clearing member must maintain Rs. 50 lakh liquid net worth. The term 'Base Minimum Capital' is not found in pages 152, 163, 170, or 181 checked.
